basic_info.description: Nestled in the desirable Parkside neighborhood, this charming ocean-view center patio home offers an exceptional location just two blocks from the Taraval MUNI lines, a variety of restaurants, and a short stroll to Noriega Street's vibrant shops. Enjoy easy access to Ocean Beach for gorgeous ocean views, Pine Lake Park for serene outdoor retreats, the convenience of Lakeshore Shopping Center, and the scenic beauty of Lake Merced. The top level of this west-facing home is bathed in natural sunlight and features a spacious living room with fireplace, a formal dining room, and a classic center patio that brings in additional light and fresh air. The eat-in kitchen is perfect for casual dining. This level also boasts a full bathroom and two generous bedrooms, both offering stunning ocean views - watch the sunset from your bedrooms!  Interior stairs lead to a legal rumpus room and full bath on the ground floor. This versatile space opens to a sizable deck, perfect for relaxation or entertaining. The garage provides one-car parking, storage, and potential expansion opportunities. A separate side entrance adds flexibility. Recently refreshed with new interior and exterior paint, refinished hardwood floors, brand-new hardwood in the lower room, and new vinyl in the downstairs bath!
